About Kampur College
In 1967 a group of spirited and resolute young men, fresh from university first decided among themselves that they would 
                  set up a college at Kampur. These youth divulged their plan to their friends, teachers (residing in the hostel of Kampur H.S. 
                  & M.P. School) who in turn, not only welcome their dream project but also pledged to finally stand by them. In the meantime a 
                  coaching class consisting of male teachers and female students was started from July, 1967. To the satisfaction of all concemed, 
                  the executive council of Gauhati University accorded the much needed permission to start P.U arts class from the session 1968-69.In fact with the permission obtained from the G.U. Kampur College came in to existing setting sail on its voyage in to the future....
Read More
From The Principal's Desk
Dr. Ashim Bora
Principal
Dear students, parents, alumni and other stackhold members of Kampur College. It is indeed a great privilege and a pleasure to welcome you all to Kampur College, Kampur. Swami Vivekananda ji, synonymous with Indian wisdom, has said that get up and wake up, and do not stop until you achieve your goal. What can be a better option than this to motivate for personality development and success in human life. There may be many factors or mediums for achieving the goal, but education is the best way by which any person can reach this summit. In fact, education and culture have an unparalled contribution in accelerating the development of human life.
To achieve this goal-objectives, along with the governance administration, the social fabric also plays its responsibility. As a result of these, educational institutions are established from time to time according to the requirements.
I feel very happy and proud to assume the responsibility of the post of Principal of Kampur College, Kampur which has completed a long journey of its life since the year 1968. Undoubtedly, this responsibility is very challenging for me, because I have got the privilege to work in such a field where there is really a need to improve both the condition and direction of education. Although there has been an unprecedented increase in the expansion of higher education in the country and state level in the last years, but it has remained mostly confined to the city-urban areas. There are many such rural and backward areas in the state where there is a need for promotion of higher education. As the Principal of this college, I myself will remain devoted to the college in every way with my words and deeds. It will be my endeavor that every working member of Kampur college family get due respect. There should be mutual cooperation and coordination amongst the various components of the college that maintains the college and everyone\'s ability, efficiency and energy can be properly utilized for the progress of the college.
I express my sincere thanks and best wishes to all the people associated with the college family, especially to you students, that Kampur College, Kampur, irrigated and nurtured by the combined energy and labour of all, will be able to establish a proud record in future. May God continue to give us good path and inspiration for this work.
With best regards,
Dr. Ashim Bora, M.Sc., Ph.D., AES
Principal
Kampur College, Kampur.

KCIANS Speak
Alpana Majumdar, Department of Economies
I am a proud student of Economics Department of Kampur College. I consider the teaching system in the economics department of our college to be an excellent educational institution. Because in our college, the teachers are teaching us exactly the way they should be teaching Our teachers teach the students in the classroom at a high level of teaching. Our teachers have been fulfilling their responsibilities to us so far in the way they should treat their children. That is why each of our teachers feels like a member of their own family.  I will forever be indebted to our teachers for this. I will always remember my life as blessed to have studied with the teachers of this department.
Bijoy Lakhi Das, Department of English
I am a proud member of English department family as well as Kampur College. My honest opinion about my college is that it is one of the best institutions and I can't imagine a better place to go for my graduation. Studying in this college is exceptionally good as the faculty focuses on each and every corner of the topic. The teachers provide study materials and their lecturers help us understand better with the amazing methods they use while taking classes. I  love the family like atmosphere that surrounds me. Our teachers freely interact with us and willingly clarify our doubts. I am so pleased and delighted to be a part of this department.
Longkiram Kro, Department of Philosophy
Our teacher has been providing us with highly informative lectures and also provided us studey materials. The department organizes educational tour to museums and art gallery for us to expose the ways in which the philosophical world view become an essential part of creative and cultural output. Our department's teacher tries to make us engage in group discussions, seminar presentation, article writing, and many more. I am so pleased and delighted to be a part of the Philosophy department.
Siba Prasad Kalita, Department of Folklore
I had chosen to study Folklore because of my love for this subject. The department’s teacher provides proper guidance in academics as well as extracurricular activities. I want to express my deep gratitude to our madam for her dedication to make us understand every concept properly and providing all relevant study materials in a well-designed manner. I am happy to be a student of the Folklore department.
Junmoni Rajkhowa, Department of Geography
I have learned many things from our department's well-experienced faculty members. Our teachers have been providing us with quality lectures and well-designed study materials for the theoretical part and also providing practical knowledge through field surveys & field trips. Our department is well-equipped with all survey-related instruments, sophisticated tracing room and GIS Lab facility. The departmental library is having syllabus related reference books which help us to save our time and concentrate more on our quality study. I am delighted to be a part of the Geography Department. Thanks to all our faculty members for their continuous effort to provide us with quality education.
Comments of Guests,Visitors & Alumni
Dr. Arun Borah, Principal, Udali College, Alumni of Kampur College
"The teacher is more than my own father, and am truly his child, his son in every respect. I owe him obedience and reverence first, before my own father even;because, they say, the father gave me this body, but he showed me the way to salvation, he is greater is than father ."
Greatest speeches of Vivekananda (page no 390). Yes, it is 100% true to my life what Swamiji had said . And this is what Kampur College, its faculty members ,its peaceful environment has offered to each and every students . The love and care of all the teachers have always inspired and motivated me . It is a matter of great pride to have been a student and now an alumna of Kampur College .
Nazrul Hussain, Associate Professor, Department of Political Science, Haji Anfar Ali College, Doboka, Alumni of Kampur College
"Literacy in itself is no education. Literacy is not the end of education or even the beginning. By education I mean an all-round drawing out of the best in the child and man-body, mind and spirit." - Mahatma Gandhi.
This quote of Gandhi absolutely true to education, it comprises the holistic development of a human being. In this context, I want to mention the name of Kampur College, the infrastructure and educational environment of the college is incomparable. The teaching staff and authority of the college tried their best level for the academic & holistic upliftment of the students. I am proud of this college, because it helped me to achieve the desired goal of my life.
Mahidul Islam, Assistant Teacher of English, Pratibha Vikash Vidyapith, Alumni of Kampur College
I fondly recall that part of my life which I spent in the rapturous ambience of Kampur College. The teachers there are always receptive to the academic needs of the students and they are driven by an inner zeal to register positive changes in the society. Their spirited academic lectures coupled with lessons on moral and ethical codes of life have played a pivotal role in my growth as a human being. I am profoundly grateful to the teachers of Kampur College who have inspired, enlightened, taught and guided me, eventually engineering the person I am today.
Jadav Payang, The Forest Man of India
I am delighted to be a part of the 55th Annual College Week closing ceremony and glad to behold the pleasant environment of Kampur College.
To make our beautiful earth evergreen is the responsibility of every individual.
Kampur, Nagaon
